title: The inverse deformation square before the diagonal dualizing comparison
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P, d≥0, separated quasi-compact finite-type smooth maps f:X→Y and g:Z→Y of pure dimension d, a finite-type structure map aY:Y→Spec k, an affine open V⊆Y, and affine diagonal geometries H,K. Let N be a normalized compact-support datum. Take a Noetherian scheme U and separated etale maps j:U→X, v:U→Z with v≫g=j≫f. Let O⊆U have lifts jO:O→f⁻¹V and vO:O→g⁻¹V commuting with the inclusions. Let n be the actual Rees-normal transport [def-pur-diagonal-etale-normal-transport] and s the independently constructed source transport [def-pur-diagonal-etale-source-transport]. Then n followed by vO*(delta_g inverse) equals jO*(delta_f inverse) followed by s. The delta maps are the uniquely normalized DNC comparisons. No alpha, rho, coefficient-unit change, dualizing-locality composite B, beta or vector integration appears in this assertion.

proof.text: For each restricted etale map construct the common Cartesian-centre span. Apply SectionRestriction.coherence Endpoints to its two etale maps and NormalizedBase to its Cartesian base-change factor. Categorical cancellation gives a single forward delta square. Identify the two endpoint composites by the source and normal endpoint lemmas.

Identify OrientationRefinement.delta with SectionRestriction.delta using uniqueness of the DNC invariant. Apply the forward square to jO and vO through their common h. Cancel the common delta_h, then the source and normal isomorphisms, obtaining the unchanged inverse-deformation equation.

theorem diagonalEtaleInverseDeformation (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (H : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry f aY d V)
    (K : P.AffineDiagonalGeometry g aY d V)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    let n := DiagonalEtaleComparison.normalTransport P d f g aY V H K U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    let s := DiagonalEtaleComparison.sourceTransport P d f g aY V H K N U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    n.hom ≫ (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).map
        (OrientationRefinement.delta P g aY d V K).inv =
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).map
        (OrientationRefinement.delta P f aY d V H).inv ≫ s.hom
